arc.en.arc1.title: Misingi
cando.en.a0.u01.sounds: Anaweza kusikia na kuiga tofauti za msingi za irabu na konsonanti za English.
cando.en.a0.u02.basics: Anaweza kutumia misemo michache ya dharura: salamu, shukrani, na kuwaomba watu wapunguze mwendo.
cando.en.a0.u02.numbers: Anaweza kusema na kuelewa namba kutoka moja hadi kumi.
cando.en.a1.u01.greet: Anaweza kusalimia watu, kujibu salamu, na kuaga kwa heshima.
cando.en.a1.u01.intro-self: Anaweza kutaja jina lake na kujitambulisha kwa sentensi rahisi.
cando.en.a1.u02.origin: Anaweza kusema anatoka nchi gani na kuwauliza wengine vivyo hivyo.
cando.en.a1.u03.family: Anaweza kutaja wanafamilia wa karibu na kusema mambo rahisi kuwahusu.
cando.en.a1.u04.count: Anaweza kuhesabu, kusema bei na umri, na kutambua namba anapozisikia.
cando.en.a1.u05.clock: Anaweza kuuliza na kutoa saa kwa maneno rahisi.
cando.en.a1.u05.dates: Anaweza kusema siku, tarehe, na tukio linapotokea.
cando.en.a1.u06.likes: Anaweza kusema chakula na kinywaji anachopenda na kutaka.
cando.en.a1.u07.order: Anaweza kuagiza chakula na kinywaji kwa heshima na kuomba bili.
cando.en.a1.u08.around-town: Anaweza kusema kilichopo mjini kwake na mahali vitu vilipo.
cando.en.a1.u09.routine: Anaweza kuelezea ratiba yake ya kila siku na mara ngapi anafanya mambo.
cando.en.a1.u10.jobs: Anaweza kusema anafanya kazi gani na kuwauliza wengine kuhusu kazi zao.
cando.en.a1.u11.possessions: Anaweza kusema anachomiliki na kuuliza wengine wanachomiliki.
cando.en.a1.u12.describe-things: Anaweza kutaja rangi na nguo na kuelezea vitu vinaonekanaje.
cando.en.a1.u13.ability: Anaweza kusema anachoweza na asichoweza kufanya na kutoa maombi rahisi.
cando.en.a1.u14.now: Anaweza kuelezea kinachoendelea karibu naye kwa wakati huu.
cando.en.a1.u15.weather: Anaweza kuzungumzia hali ya hewa na misimu kwa maneno rahisi.
cando.en.a1.u16.transport: Anaweza kununua tiketi, kufuata maelekezo rahisi, na kutumia usafiri wa umma.
cando.en.a1.u17.prices: Anaweza kuuliza bei ya vitu na kufanya manunuzi rahisi.
cando.en.a1.u18.describe-people: Anaweza kuelezea watu wanaonekanaje na tabia zao.
cando.en.a1.u19.hobbies: Anaweza kuzungumzia burudani na shughuli za wakati wa ziada anazofurahia.
cando.en.a1.u20.past: Anaweza kusema alikuwa wapi na alifanya nini katika sentensi rahisi za wakati uliopita.
cando.en.a1.u21.tell-past: Anaweza kusimulia hadithi fupi kuhusu wiki iliyopita akitumia vitenzi vya kawaida vya wakati uliopita.
cando.en.a1.u22.plans: Anaweza kuzungumzia mipango na kuwaalika watu kufanya mambo pamoja.
cando.en.a1.u23.feelings: Anaweza kusema anajisikiaje na kuelezea matatizo rahisi ya kiafya.
cando.en.a1.u24.home: Anaweza kuelezea nyumba yake na vyumba na vitu vilivyomo.
cando.en.a1.u25.compare: Anaweza kulinganisha watu, mahali, na vitu katika sentensi rahisi.
cando.en.a1.u26.connect: Anaweza kuunganisha mawazo rahisi kwa kutumia and, but, na because.
cando.en.a1.u27.about-me: Anaweza kujitambulisha kwa kifupi kwa mdomo: yeye ni nani, anafanya nini, na anapenda nini.
cando.en.a1.u28.show: Anaweza kuunganisha mada zote za arc katika kipindi kimoja cha marudio.
gn.en.gn.adv-freq.note: Maneno kama usually, often, na sometimes yanaeleza mara kwa mara tabia inafanyika. Huwekwa kabla ya kitenzi kikuu na baada ya be: "I usually walk. She is often late."
gn.en.gn.adv-freq.title: Vielezi vya marudio
gn.en.gn.art-the.note: "The" inamaanisha kile tunachokijua sote: "the station", "the sun", au kutajwa kwa mara ya pili. Wingi wa jumla huacha the: "I like dogs."
gn.en.gn.art-the.title: the (msingi)
gn.en.gn.articles-a-an.note: Tumia "a" kabla ya sauti za konsonanti na "an" kabla ya sauti za irabu: a book, an apple, an hour. Huashiria kitu kimoja, kisicho maalum.
gn.en.gn.articles-a-an.title: a / an
gn.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.note: "Am" huenda na I, na "are" huenda na you: "I am Anna. You are my friend." Njia hizi mbili hutumika katika utambulisho wako wa kwanza.
gn.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.title: be: I am / you are
gn.en.gn.be-all.note: Am, is, na are kwa nafsi zote: he, she, na it huchukua "is"; we, you, na they huchukua "are". "She is a doctor. They are from Peru."
gn.en.gn.be-all.title: be: wakati uliopo kamili
gn.en.gn.be-neg.note: Ongeza "not" baada ya be: "I am not tired. She isn't here." Njia fupi isn't na aren't husikika asilia zaidi katika mazungumzo.
gn.en.gn.be-neg.title: be: kukanusha
gn.en.gn.be-yesno-q.note: Geuza be iwe mbele: "You are tired." inakuwa "Are you tired?" Mpangilio wa maneno pekee huifanya iwe swali — hakuna neno la ziada linalohitajika.
gn.en.gn.be-yesno-q.title: Maswali ya Ndiyo/Hapana na be
gn.en.gn.can-ability.note: "I can swim. He can't drive." Njia moja kwa kila nafsi, na kitenzi kinachofuata hubaki katika hali yake ya asili.
gn.en.gn.can-ability.title: can / can't (uwezo)
gn.en.gn.can-request.note: "Can I have the menu? Can you help me?" — ombi la heshima la kila siku, kwa ruhusa na msaada.
gn.en.gn.can-request.title: can (maombi)
gn.en.gn.comp-superl.note: Vivumishi vifupi huchukua -er na -est (older, the oldest); virefu hutumia more na most. Good inakuwa better na best. Linganisha na "than": "My city is bigger than yours."
gn.en.gn.comp-superl.title: Vilinganishi na vishirikishi
gn.en.gn.conn-basic.note: Unganisha mawazo: "I like tea and coffee. It's small but nice. I stayed home because I was tired."
gn.en.gn.conn-basic.title: and / but / because
gn.en.gn.dem-sg.note: "This" huashiria kitu kilicho karibu nawe na "that" huashiria kitu kilicho mbali zaidi: "This is my phone. That is your bag."
gn.en.gn.dem-sg.title: this / that
gn.en.gn.do-neg.note: "I don't know. She doesn't eat meat." Don't au doesn't pamoja na kitenzi asilia — -s huhamia kwenye "does" na kuacha kitenzi.
gn.en.gn.do-neg.title: Kukanusha na don't/doesn't
gn.en.gn.do-quest.note: "Do you like tea? Does she work here?" Do au does huanzisha swali na kitenzi kikuu hubaki katika hali yake ya asili.
gn.en.gn.do-quest.title: Maswali na do/does
gn.en.gn.dummy-it.note: English inahitaji kiima hata kwa hali ya hewa na wakati: "It is raining. It's cold. It's late." "It" haiashirii chochote — inajaza tu nafasi ya kiima.
gn.en.gn.dummy-it.title: it kwa hali ya hewa na wakati
gn.en.gn.going-to.note: Be pamoja na going to pamoja na kitenzi kwa mipango: "I'm going to visit my aunt tomorrow. We're going to travel in June."
gn.en.gn.going-to.title: going to (mipango)
gn.en.gn.have-got.note: Umiliki: "I have two brothers. She has a car." Unaweza pia kusikia "have got" — ichukulie kama ina maana sawa.
gn.en.gn.have-got.title: have / has
gn.en.gn.how-much-many.note: "How many" na vitu vinavyohesabika ("How many apples?") na "how much" na visivyohesabika ("How much water?"). Bei hutumia "How much is it?"
gn.en.gn.how-much-many.title: How much / How many
gn.en.gn.imperatives.note: Mwambie mtu afanye nini kwa kutumia kitenzi asilia: "Turn left. Wait here. Please don't stop." Kuongeza "please" huifanya iwe ya kirafiki.
gn.en.gn.imperatives.title: Amri
gn.en.gn.like-want-noun.note: Kitenzi pamoja na kitu, hakuna kitu katikati: "I like coffee. I want water." Mtu anayependa ndiye kiima.
gn.en.gn.like-want-noun.title: like / want + nomino
gn.en.gn.numbers-1-100.note: Hesabu hadi mia moja na zingatia mtego wa -teen dhidi ya -ty: thirteen na thirty husikika karibu, hivyo mkazo huwatofautisha.
gn.en.gn.numbers-1-100.title: Namba 1–100
gn.en.gn.obj-pron.note: Me, you, him, her, it, us, them — huja baada ya kitenzi: "Call me. I see her. Ask him."
gn.en.gn.obj-pron.title: Viwakilishi vya shamirisho
gn.en.gn.past-be.note: Wakati uliopita wa be: I, he, she, na it huchukua "was"; you, we, na they huchukua "were". "I was at home. They were happy."
gn.en.gn.past-be.title: was / were
gn.en.gn.past-irreg-top25.note: Vitenzi vya kawaida hubadilisha umbo katika wakati uliopita: go na went, have na had, see na saw, do na did, get na got, make na made.
gn.en.gn.past-irreg-top25.title: Wakati uliopita usio wa kawaida (vitenzi vikuu)
gn.en.gn.past-quest-neg.note: "Did you see it? I didn't go." Did hubeba wakati uliopita, hivyo kitenzi kikuu hurudi katika hali yake ya asili.
gn.en.gn.past-quest-neg.title: did: maswali na kukanusha
gn.en.gn.past-reg.note: Ongeza -ed kwa vitendo vilivyokamilika: "I worked. She visited her mother." Umbo hilo hilo hufanya kazi kwa kila nafsi.
gn.en.gn.past-reg.title: Wakati uliopita rahisi: -ed
gn.en.gn.plural-irreg.note: Baadhi ya nomino hubadilika badala ya kuongeza -s: man na men, woman na women, child na children, person na people, foot na feet.
gn.en.gn.plural-irreg.title: Wingi usio wa kawaida
gn.en.gn.plural-reg.note: Ongeza -s kwa zaidi ya moja, au -es baada ya s, sh, ch, na x: one cat, two cats; one box, two boxes.
gn.en.gn.plural-reg.title: Wingi wa kawaida
gn.en.gn.poss-adj.note: My, your, his, her, its, our, their — viweke kabla ya nomino: "her book", "our house", "their names".
gn.en.gn.poss-adj.title: Vivumishi vya umiliki
gn.en.gn.poss-s.note: Ongeza 's kwa mmiliki: "Anna's dog", "my brother's car". English huweka mmiliki kwanza na kitu kinachomilikiwa pili.
gn.en.gn.poss-s.title: Umiliki 's
gn.en.gn.prep-place.note: In, on, under, next to, behind, in front of, between — maneno madogo yanayoelezea mahali: "The keys are on the table."
gn.en.gn.prep-place.title: Viunganishi vya mahali
gn.en.gn.pres-cont.note: Be pamoja na kitenzi-ing kwa sasa hivi: "I am eating. They are working. Look, it is raining."
gn.en.gn.pres-cont.title: Wakati uliopo endelevu
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.note: Na he, she, na it, kitenzi huchukua -s: "She works. He watches." Ni herufi inayofahamika kidogo katika English, hivyo ipe umakini wa ziada.
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.title: Nafsi ya 3 -s
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-base.note: Kwa tabia na ukweli, tumia kitenzi asilia: "I work at home. They live in Lima." Hakuna mabadiliko ya viishio kwa viima hivi.
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-base.title: Wakati uliopo rahisi: I / you / we / they
gn.en.gn.pron-subject.note: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. English inataka kiima kitajwe kwa sauti katika karibu kila sentensi — "am tired" inahitaji "I" yake.
gn.en.gn.pron-subject.title: Viwakilishi vya kiima
gn.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.note: "I drink coffee every day" ni tabia; "I am drinking coffee" ni wakati huu. Maneno ya wakati ndiyo dalili yako.
gn.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.title: Tabia au sasa hivi?
gn.en.gn.some-any.note: "Some" katika sentensi chanya ("I have some money") na "any" katika kukanusha na maswali ("Do you have any money?").
gn.en.gn.some-any.title: some / any
gn.en.gn.sv-order.note: Sentensi za English huenda Kiima–Kitenzi–Shamirisho: "I eat apples." Mpangilio hubeba maana, hivyo weka mtendaji kwanza na kitendo pili.
gn.en.gn.sv-order.title: Mpangilio wa maneno wa msingi
gn.en.gn.there-is-are.note: Kusema kitu kipo: "There is a bank. There are two cafes." Linganisha is au are na idadi ya vitu unavyomaanisha.
gn.en.gn.there-is-are.title: there is / there are
gn.en.gn.time-prep.note: "At" kwa saa (at five), "on" kwa siku na tarehe (on Monday), "in" kwa miezi, miaka, na sehemu za siku (in May, in the morning).
gn.en.gn.time-prep.title: at / on / in kwa wakati
gn.en.gn.time-telling.note: Anza na "It's": "It's three o'clock. It's half past two. It's seven fifteen." "It" hubaki hata kama hakuna kitu kilichotajwa.
gn.en.gn.time-telling.title: Kueleza saa
gn.en.gn.wh-quest-be.note: What, where, who, au how, kisha be, kisha kiima: "Where are you? What is this? Who is that?"
gn.en.gn.wh-quest-be.title: Maswali ya Wh- na be
gn.en.gn.would-like.note: "I'd like a coffee, please" ndiyo njia ya heshima ya kuagiza au kuomba kitu — laini zaidi kuliko "I want".
gn.en.gn.would-like.title: I'd like (kwa heshima)
